worldcombat.skill.grassyterrain.summary: Plant grass on a chosen patch of ground: bodies standing on it slowly recover health, Grass moves hit harder, and Earthquake and Bulldoze are halved by the roots. With dense planting it also tends plants inside the grass. It treats both sides alike.
worldcombat.skill.grassyterrain.descript: Plant a grass field of radius %1$s blocks on the chosen ground, lasting %2$s.
A body standing on the grass recovers %1$s of its maximum health every %2$s; the grass treats both sides alike.
with dense planting it tends plants up to %1$s times.
Starts up in %1$s and settles in %2$s, both driven by Speed.
worldcombat.skill.grassyterrain.timing: Cast at ground within %1$s blocks; after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP to plant the grass, recovers %3$s, and commits a %5$s cooldown on cast.
worldcombat.skill.grassyterrain.growth.0: At level %1$s the committed cooldown drops to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.grassyterrain.growth.1: At level %1$s the committed cooldown drops again to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.grassyterrain.preferen: On = dense planting: heals stronger (x1.25) and tends nearby sprouts, but the grass is smaller (x0.82), shorter (x0.85) and cooldown +16 ticks. Off = wild grass: larger, longer, cooldown -12 ticks, but heals only and tends nothing.
The companion only plants grass while a threat is within this distance; lower plants up close, higher sets it up in advance.
Push the grass at the foe
On, the grass is planted between you and the threat so the fighting line falls on it; off, it is planted at your feet to hold you first.
On, a companion holding its station will step out to plant grass.
